# secret-subscription

Materialises a value another cluster published, as a Secret here.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| annotations | attribute set of string | `{}` | Annotations on the Secret. |
| fields | attribute set of string | `{}` | Template for the Secret's data, for a consumer that wants the value under a key of its own choosing.  |
| labels | attribute set of string | `{}` | Labels on the Secret, for what finds it by label rather than by name. |
| namespace | string | `"default"` | Namespace the Secret lands in. |
| refreshInterval | string | `"1h"` | How often the value is read again.  A refresh, not a re-mint: the producer owns the value and this reads it, so an interval here costs a read and never a new credential.  |
| secret | string | *(required)* | Name the value is called here. Required.  What it was called where it was minted is the producer's business; this is a name that says what it is in this cluster.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| publication | [PUBLISHED_SECRET](../signatures/PUBLISHED_SECRET.md) | A value one cluster pushed into a lab store, and where to read it. |
| secretStore | [SECRET_STORE](../signatures/SECRET_STORE.md) | A named store an ExternalSecret reads from, and whether it may be written to. |
